odd_even_process_pairs.even_uncertainty_reduced: Reduced: the cost-robustness of the candidate is now classified (COST_ROBUST at lookbacks 3/5/10, canonical 5) with a reproducible artifact and independent recomputation. Not resolved: the result is conditional on the engine's constant-dollar fixed-notional sizing (low absolute cost drag); a compounding/equity-scaled sizing or higher-slippage cost surface remains untested, and the gap-widening is partly a matched-null turnover effect.

validated_information_gained.uncertainty_reduced: Reduced: durable evidence shows the frontier-first selection practice is associated with improved information flow (decisive, non-duplicated, independently verified cell closures) relative to the prior opportunistic period. Not resolved: the selector's isolated causal magnitude, because the improvement is confounded with co-occurring process changes and only one selection exists in this campaign.
validated_information_gained.uncertainty_targeted: Whether explicit highest-value focused-task selection improves information flow relative to opportunistic queue choice, and whether the controller's deterministic ordinal selector (as opposed to the broader frontier-first practice) is the operative cause.
